Use case: illustration-story / source-faithful architectural style-transfer.
Create ONE finished opaque narrative setting plate: C01-ARCH-VEINPORT, Veinport harbor and civic districts. Native1672 x941 landscape preferred, with a safe exact centered1664 x936 crop. Complete edge-to-edge illustration, no panels or frame.
REFERENCE ROLES: image1 is the exact original Veinport source cell and the sole architectural/layout/material authority. Image2 concept-v2 is the approved chunky matte cartoon family and broad-plane simplification. Image3 Ansel demonstrates polished narrative scenery in that style only: do NOT copy its isolated medical tower, open hospital beds, bronze pipe system or forest-only setting.
PRESERVE SOURCE IDENTITY: A modest working river harbor among autumn olive/rust trees and slate rocky banks. At screen-left, blue-gray river water borders a long angular timber quay with several broad wooden piers, two simple lifting cranes, moored small brown river boats, cargo crates and barrels. On land are THREE DISTINCT but connected civic/working precincts, not time panels: an upper substantial timber-and-stone civic/service compound with a dark slate central gabled hall and several stout round capped corner turrets, a small grain shed and hay/sack stacks; a middle open MARKET ENCLOSURE with chunky blue, green and rust canvas stalls, goods and a public stone well; and a lower/right watch-and-transport yard with a squat timber gatehouse/watchtower, wagon, horse and a few guards. Simple low timber palisades separate compounds, broad earth roads connect them to each other and the riverfront. Preserve this ensemble instead of inventing a huge coastal metropolis or palace skyline.
CANONICAL ROLE: Veinport is a trading city where unions, old officials, medical services, granaries and the local council must coexist through uprising, governance crisis and council formation. Show a useful shared civic setting: dockworkers loading cargo, a few people trading, and a modest public ledger table under the civic hall porch with two separate adult representatives. This is a neutral single setting plate and does not claim to show all three historical stages at once. No uprising combat, forced kneeling, fire, heroic coronation, named character portraits, giant throne, crowd worship or literal chosen ending. All people anonymous secondary compact adults, no flags claiming an invented political allegiance. Do not add readable writing.
COMPOSITION: Elevated three-quarter establishing view with visible building fronts, broad playable-looking paths but NO grid. Recompose the original square ensemble into a unified landscape. The turreted civic hall is upper center nearx840, full main mass between roughlyx620 andx1070 with entire roof and finials belowy65. The open market court runs down toward center foreground. Riverfront occupies the left third; one chunky wooden pier reaches toward lower center and a moored small boat remains visible nearx750-900 at the bottom, so a centered narrow portrait crop retains civic hall plus market and a hint of the harbor. The full river quay, outer cranes, watch yard and outer stall groups are lateral context. Keep spacious clear paths between groups; about7-9 broad canvas stalls,2 lifting cranes,4 small boats,14-18 anonymous people maximum. No building tip or major structure cut by the native canvas edges.
STYLE: Exact approved concept-v2 chunky fantasy narrative style, strong stable dark contours, exaggerated thick beams and posts, broad stone blocks, clean large slate roof planes, substantial simple boats and broad cloth awnings, compact adults with slightly enlarged heads/hands. Flat matte cel-painted surfaces with2-3 shades per material. Bright enough to read every district, natural quiet daytime, cool slate/river blue, warm earth/brown, muted olive and russet autumn foliage, restrained colored awnings. Ground is quiet broad earth planes with only a few large paving stones. Water is broad graphic facets and a few simple ripples, not glitter or noisy reflections. NO microtexture, tiny repeated rivets, stone pores, scratches, grain noise, thousands of leaf marks, fine gravel, photorealism, glossy metal or atmospheric blur. Preserve original functional working-port feel, not a festival.
CONSTRAINTS: One coherent opaque narrative architectural setting, not a transparent sprite sheet, three-panel triptych, labeled map, flat diagram or UI screenshot. No text, numbers, logos, watermark, border, invented emblems, dragons, magic beams, modern machinery or objects borrowed from style references. No coastline/ocean horizon or tall sailing ships: this is a river harbor. Keep the distinct river piers, open market, turreted civic compound and modest watch yard legible in the wide composition.
